# Feature: One-way door — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #4 (One-way door) from Movement Tiles before it is used in real levels. Effect: pass in one direction only. Unique: a wall from one side, a door from the other. Useful: creates commitment and loops with no backtracking. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** pass in one direction only.

**So that** creates commitment and loops with no backtracking.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets One-way door for the first time in its teaching room (mech-4-one-way-door-room). Teaching moment: First room: an orb sits beyond a one-way door, with a long loop back. A player who goes through for the orb and then tries to come back the way they came finds a wall and must take the loop, which teaches that the door's direction is a commitment made before entering. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Walkable only in its arrow direction and a wall from the other three sides, shown by chevrons
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Passing through never consumes anything and it never resets

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Walkable only in its arrow direction and a wall from the other three sides, shown by chevrons
- Passing through never consumes anything and it never resets
- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees One-way door's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-4-one-way-door-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/movement-tiles.yml mechanic #4.
